sentences.text: Researchers evaluated the Graus criteria in a group of humans, finding the tool correctly identified 89% of patients with autoimmune encephalitis and correctly excluded 96% of those without the condition.
Among the surviving patients with autoimmune encephalitis, 65% continued to show cognitive impairment after three months, a pattern the authors defined as the progression to autoimmune dementia.
The authors note that their results are limited to patients seen at specialized referral centers and need to be confirmed in wider settings.
